title: Propagate the ~7s wall-clock fast-tier timing correction to agent docs (developer.md, reviewer.md + mirrors)
description: Follow-up to TASK-151 (which corrected the stale "~2s" fast-tier claim to "~2s test-execution / ~7s wall-clock" in CLAUDE.md and vitest.config.js). The developer's punch list flagged that the agent definition docs still carry the old phrasing: agents/developer.md:46 and agents/reviewer.md:23 say "(fast tier, ~2s ...)" when describing the per-ticket gate, and the .claude/agents/ parity mirrors carry the same text. Update those spots to match TASK-151's corrected wording so the timing claim is consistent across all process docs. CRITICAL: agents/ and .claude/agents/ copies must stay byte-identical — tests/agents-parity.spec.js enforces this; edit both copies of each file identically. Docs-only, no behavior change -> uat-only.
acceptance_criteria: agents/developer.md and agents/reviewer.md no longer claim the fast tier is "~2s" bare; each corrected spot matches TASK-151's convention (~2s test-execution / ~7s wall-clock, or the honest wall-clock figure)
The .claude/agents/ mirror copies receive byte-identical edits (tests/agents-parity.spec.js stays green)
No other content in the agent files changes; grep for "~2s" across the repo's md docs finds no remaining bare stale claims about the fast tier
UAT: the timing claim is consistent across CLAUDE.md, vitest.config.js, and all four agent files

comments.author: uat
comments.body:
UAT script (one step per AC), overall result: PASS (4/4). All steps verified by Orchestrator at the human's request ("push and do the follow-up").

1. AC1 — grep agents/developer.md + agents/reviewer.md for "~2s". Expected: no bare claim; corrected spots match TASK-151's convention. Observed: both now read "(fast tier, ~2s test-execution / ~7s wall-clock — ...)". PASS.
2. AC2 — byte-identity of .claude/agents/ mirrors. Expected: identical; agents-parity spec green. Observed: SHA-256 equal for both pairs (independently re-hashed by Orchestrator); tests/agents-parity.spec.js 3/3 green. PASS.
3. AC3 — no other content changed; repo-wide md grep for stale "~2s". Expected: only correct "test-execution" mentions remain. Observed: commit 0f24b1a is a single-line edit per file (×4); remaining "~2s" hits are the corrected phrasings (CLAUDE.md ×3, vitest.config.js, 4 agent files) plus historical records (a dated 2026-07-02 session artifact and ticket bodies) which are not live process docs. PASS.
4. AC4 — consistency across CLAUDE.md, vitest.config.js, and all four agent files. Expected: one timing convention everywhere. Observed: all seven live docs use "~2s test-execution / ~7s wall-clock". PASS.

Gate: npm run test:changed = no specs selected (expected for md-only diff); npm test = 977 passed / 2 skipped. Affected-e2e: none (only fast-tier parity/permissions specs reference these files).
